nat_charge: Attacks have a {chance} chance to charge (charging takes one action): the next action unleashes a guaranteed hit with +{crit} crit rate and damage raised to {value}.
nat_execution: While enemy HP is below {threshold}, attacks have a {chance} chance to raise damage to {value}.
nat_lifesteal: Attacks have a {chance} chance to enter bloodthirst: for {turns} actions, {value} of damage dealt converts to HP.
nat_poison: Attacks have a {chance} chance to poison the enemy: {damage} damage per action, lasting {ticks} ticks.
nat_concussive: Attacks have a {chance} chance to land a concussive blow: that strike ignores {value} of DEF, and on hit the enemy cannot act for {ticks} ticks.
nat_thunder: Attacks have a {chance} chance to replace the strike with thunder: up to {max} bolts of true damage, each worth {value} of ATK; each later bolt's chance is {decay} of the previous.
nat_sever: When the enemy is about to act, {chance} chance to sever their turn: the action is interrupted, an immediate counter deals {value} damage, and their gauge is knocked back {delay}.
nat_gauge_surge: After a landed hit, {chance} chance to advance the gauge by {value} extra ({crit_value} on a critical hit).
nat_damage_reduction: Each hit taken has a {chance} chance to add a forge mark: damage reduction +{value} per stack for {ticks} ticks, stacking without limit.
nat_reflect: Each hit taken has a {chance} chance to backlash: negate {value} of the damage and reflect it at {ratio} back at the attacker.
nat_bulwark: While own HP is at least {threshold}, damage taken is reduced by {value}, with an {immune} chance to ignore it entirely.
nat_retribution: Each hit taken has a {chance} chance to record its damage (up to {cap} records): the next landed hit adds the recorded total at {ratio}.
nat_iron_will: Fatal damage has a {chance} chance to trigger defiance: recover {value} of max HP and survive; each trigger decays the chance to {decay} of itself.
nat_heal: At the start of an action, {chance} chance to recover {value} HP and gain a renewal mark: {regen} HP every {tick} ticks for {duration} ticks.
nat_cleanse: At the start of an action, {chance} chance to purify: dispel all marks and buffs/debuffs on both sides ({per} HP per kind dispelled) and recover {value} HP.
nat_low_hp_atk_bonus: Once HP falls below {threshold}, ATK +{value} and SPD +{spd} for the rest of the fight.
nat_streak_bonus: Each landed hit has a {chance} chance to gain a momentum stack: +{value} damage per stack (max {cap}); a miss resets the streak.
nat_overload: Attacks have a {chance} chance to overload: spend {cost} of max HP to raise that strike's damage to {value}.
nat_armor_shred: Attacks have a {chance} chance to shatter armor: DEF −{value} for {ticks} ticks, stacking up to {max_stacks} times.
nat_bleed: Attacks have a {chance} chance to cause bleeding: {value} of the attacker's ATK as damage per action, lasting {ticks} ticks.
nat_gamble: Attacks have a {chance} chance to go all in: damage rises to {value}, otherwise it drops to {penalty}.
nat_tempo: After each action, {chance} chance to gain +{value} SPD, stacking without limit.
nat_armor_pen: Attacks have a {chance} chance to see the flaw: that strike ignores all DEF and gains +{crit} crit rate.
nat_blood_pact: At the start of each action, {chance} chance to sacrifice: spend {cost} of max HP, that attack drains {value} as lifesteal; after the action, lifesteal converts to permanent ATK at {convert}.
nat_grudge: Each hit taken has a {chance} chance to hoard 1 grudge stack (lasting {ticks} ticks): +{value} damage per stack, no stack limit.
link_difference: The more {own} exceeds {enemy}, the higher the {field}.
link_sum: The higher {own} plus {enemy}, the higher the {field}.
